concerns.text: T017 (Integration test) depends on T014 (Raw data saved), but T014 is marked incomplete in the task list. The test cannot execute without the producer artifact. Re-order or mark T014 as a prerequisite block.

T022 (Train Model), T023 (Evaluate), and T024 (Feature Importance) are marked incomplete, yet T027 (Unit test for preprocess) is marked complete. While T027 tests preprocessing, the downstream modeling tasks (T022-24) are consumers of the preprocessed data (T015/T019). If T022-24 are not implemented, the 'Independent Test' for US2 cannot run, breaking the shippable unit requirement.

T029b (Batch covariate/SVA) depends on T015 (Harmonized Data), which is marked incomplete. T029a (Permutation) depends on T029b. This creates a chain where the entire US3 validation phase is blocked by an incomplete upstream artifact (T015). The ordering implies US3 cannot start until T015 is done, but T015 is not prioritized as a blocker.

T029a depends on T021 (Split indices) and T029b. T021 is marked complete, but T029b is incomplete. The dependency chain is valid, but the 'Checkpoint' text claims 'All user stories should now be independently functional' while critical tasks (T015, T022-24, T029b) are incomplete. The ordering logic is sound, but the state of completion contradicts the checkpoint claim.

T012 (Categorical-to-ordinal) is marked incomplete, but T013 (Herbivore density) is marked complete. T013 logic ('If present... If missing...') likely depends on the resistance column being numeric or ordinal. If T012 is required to make resistance numeric, T013 should depend on T012. The current order implies T013 can run on raw categorical data, which may violate the 'numeric' requirement of FR-008.

T048 (Report generation) depends on T031 (Null Result check) and T034 (Significant biomarkers). T031 and T034 are marked incomplete. The report cannot be generated without these validation outputs. The ordering is correct (consumer after producer), but the incomplete status of producers makes the consumer task impossible to execute, violating the 'independently shippable' unit check for the final phase.
